Malappuram Stray Dog Attacks Leave Infant Injured

A 5-month-old baby was seriously injured after being attacked by a stray dog in Malappuram's Othukkungal. The incident highlights concerns about animal welfare and public safety in the region. Authorities have been urged to take action against stray dogs that pose a threat to human lives.
